Total RNA was quantified using a sphectrophometrically. Directional cDNA libraries for mRNA-sequencing were prepared using polyA-mRNA from individual RNA samples using Illumina TruSeq reagents. Pooled cDNA libraries were sequenced (150 bp paired reads) using a NovaSeq 6000 instrument.

Total RNA was quantified using a sphectrophometrically. Directional cDNA libraries for mRNA-sequencing were prepared using polyA-mRNA from individual RNA samples using Illumina TruSeq reagents. Libraries were generated via PCR including dual-indexed barcodes. Following purification with AmpureXP beads libraries were quantitated using Qubit dsDNA reagents. Pooled cDNA libraries were sequenced (150 bp paired reads) using a NovaSeq 6000 instrument.
